text:
Natalia Bar I understand your story, and I understand how when a person with authority who has power over you says something, or demands something, you think they are acting professionally and in good faith. I don't disrespect your experience.

In practice, if they forced you to register your marriage abroad as a condition to continue/finish they process, they were demanding something they are not authorized to demand, and they were violating your rights by doing so. 

Imagine they demanded to take your phone and scroll through your entire photo gallery. Obviously they are not authorized to do so and you would refuse, right? And refusing could lead to delays and "fights" with them and maybe even having to go to court. But if you did go to court, you would win.
So the same with the marriage registration.
